\section[(dialogue)]{The house, things you carry and school — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R130-first-pass-the-house-things-you-carry-and-school}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a frog and a tortoise.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item rasam, butter, an egg, a fish, meat
  \item vegetables, a banana, a mango, a coconut, an onion
  \item a tomato, a chilli, ginger, garlic, honey
  \item an idli, a dosa, a vadai, coffee, the sea
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Rasam? (\textbf{\ta{ரசம்}}, \emph{rasam}.) Butter? (\textbf{\ta{வெண்ணெய்}}, \emph{veṇṇey}.) An egg? (\textbf{\ta{முட்டை}}, \emph{muṭṭai}.) A fish? (\textbf{\ta{மீன்}}, \emph{mīṉ}.) Meat? (\textbf{\ta{இறைச்சி}}, \emph{iṟaicci}.) Vegetables? (\textbf{\ta{காய்கறி}}, \emph{kāykaṟi}.) A banana? (\textbf{\ta{வாழைப்பழம்}}, \emph{vāḻaippaḻam}.) A mango? (\textbf{\ta{மாம்பழம்}}, \emph{māmpaḻam}.) A coconut? (\textbf{\ta{தேங்காய்}}, \emph{tēṅkāy}.) An onion? (\textbf{\ta{வெங்காயம்}}, \emph{veṅkāyam}.) A tomato? (\textbf{\ta{தக்காளி}}, \emph{takkāḷi}.) A chilli? (\textbf{\ta{மிளகாய்}}, \emph{milakāy}.) Ginger? (\textbf{\ta{இஞ்சி}}, \emph{iñci}.) Garlic? (\textbf{\ta{பூண்டு}}, \emph{pūṇṭu}.) Honey? (\textbf{\ta{தேன்}}, \emph{tēṉ}.) An idli? (\textbf{\ta{இட்லி}}, \emph{iṭli}.) A dosa? (\textbf{\ta{தோசை}}, \emph{tōcai}.) A vadai? (\textbf{\ta{வடை}}, \emph{vaṭai}.) Coffee? (\textbf{\ta{காபி}}, \emph{kāpi}.) The sea? (\textbf{\ta{கடல்}}, \emph{kaṭal}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Food — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R130-second-pass-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a lake and a pond.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a lake, a pond, a forest, a leaf, soil
  \item a star, dew, thunder, lightning, a storm
  \item a wave, a buffalo, a horse, an elephant, a tiger
  \item a lion, a bear, a monkey, a rabbit, a deer
  \item a fox, a snake, a rat, a frog, a tortoise
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A lake? (\textbf{\ta{ஏரி}}, \emph{ēri}.) A pond? (\textbf{\ta{குளம்}}, \emph{kuḷam}.) A forest? (\textbf{\ta{காடு}}, \emph{kāṭu}.) A leaf? (\textbf{\ta{இலை}}, \emph{ilai}.) Soil? (\textbf{\ta{மண்}}, \emph{maṇ}.) A star? (\textbf{\ta{நட்சத்திரம்}}, \emph{naṭcattiram}.) Dew? (\textbf{\ta{பனி}}, \emph{paṉi}.) Thunder? (\textbf{\ta{இடி}}, \emph{iṭi}.) Lightning? (\textbf{\ta{மின்னல்}}, \emph{miṉṉal}.) A storm? (\textbf{\ta{புயல்}}, \emph{puyal}.) A wave? (\textbf{\ta{அலை}}, \emph{alai}.) A buffalo? (\textbf{\ta{எருமை}}, \emph{erumai}.) A horse? (\textbf{\ta{குதிரை}}, \emph{kutirai}.) An elephant? (\textbf{\ta{யானை}}, \emph{yāṉai}.) A tiger? (\textbf{\ta{புலி}}, \emph{puli}.) A lion? (\textbf{\ta{சிங்கம்}}, \emph{ciṅkam}.) A bear? (\textbf{\ta{கரடி}}, \emph{karaṭi}.) A monkey? (\textbf{\ta{குரங்கு}}, \emph{kuraṅku}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{\ta{முயல்}}, \emph{muyal}.) A deer? (\textbf{\ta{மான்}}, \emph{māṉ}.) A fox? (\textbf{\ta{நரி}}, \emph{nari}.) A snake? (\textbf{\ta{பாம்பு}}, \emph{pāmpu}.) A rat? (\textbf{\ta{எலி}}, \emph{eli}.) A frog? (\textbf{\ta{தவளை}}, \emph{tavaḷai}.) A tortoise? (\textbf{\ta{ஆமை}}, \emph{āmai}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
